references.text: Moses gives detailed instructions about cities of refuge in the promised land, expanding on the concept introduced in Deut. 4:41
Refers specifically to three cities to be set apart, the same number Moses appointed on the east side of the Jordan
God's command to Moses to establish cities of refuge, including three cities on the east side of the Jordan
Mentions all six cities of refuge in total, three of which were to be located east of the Jordan
Joshua appoints the three cities of refuge east of the Jordan: Bezer, Ramoth, and Golan, fulfilling Moses' instruction
Names Bezer, Ramoth-Gilead, and Golan as Levitical cities and cities of refuge on the east side of the Jordan
The fundamental principle of a place of refuge for unintentional killing, which the cities of refuge are built upon
